ABS Outstanding : 1. As per the Owner Representative, ship’s Doppler Sonar was found abnormal & affected transmitting the messages of STW (Speed Through Water) to Radar & ECDIS. Entries of MPA Logbook & Ship’s Logbook were reviewed and uploaded into work order.
2. The error STW messages of Doppler Sonar was examined & found affected to three(3) Radars and two(2) ECDISs. 
Meantime, two(2) GPS & one(1) AIS were examined & operationally tested, confirmed the functions & transmitting the speed messages of GPSs/AIS to Radars & ECDISs to be in order.  
3. Service Engineers were onboard ship to examine & repair the abnormal Doppler Sonar on 17 January 2026 & 02 December 2025, and service reports were reviewed and same was uploaded into work order.
4. Control measures of ship’s Risk Assessment for Shipboard Operations (Form: FM-0401-1) & Training Record (Form: FM-0804-1) dated 21 April 2026 was reviewed against situation of abnormal Doppler Sonar, and same was uploaded into work order.
Master was advised that all officers & navigation watch seafarers are to be closely monitored ship’s speed information through GPSs/AIS. 
 5. Reference with MPA Circular NO. 10 of 2025 - Issuance of Dispensation by Recognised Organisations (ROs), a short-term Cargo Ship Safety Equipment Certificate and a Statutory Condition (SC) with a validity until 29 June 2026 to allow the Singapore-registered ship to continue her voyage, pending repair or replace the malfunctioned Doppler Sonar.
